name: Monthly Modal Time Series
description:
Modal Service data and Safety & Security (S&S) public transit time series data delineated by transit/agency/mode/year/month. Includes all Full Reporters--transit agencies operating modes with more than 30 vehicles in maximum service--to the National Transit Database (NTD). This dataset will be updated monthly. 

The monthly ridership data is released one month after the month in which the service is provided. Records with null monthly service data reflect late reporting. 

The S&S statistics provided include both Major and Non-Major Events where applicable. Events occurring in the past three months are excluded from the corresponding monthly ridership rows in this dataset while they undergo validation. This dataset is the only NTD publication in which all Major and Non-Major S&S data are presented without any adjustment for historical continuity.

columns.name: Mode Name
columns.description: A system for carrying transit passengers described by specific right-of-way (ROW), technology and operational features.

columns.name: Mode
columns.description: A system for carrying transit passengers described by specific right-of-way (ROW), technology and operational features.

columns.name: Type of Service
columns.description: Describes how public transportation services are provided by the transit agency: directly operated (DO) or purchased transportation which also includes from Taxi Operators and Transportation Network Companies (PT, TX, TN) services.

columns.name: Fixed Route Flag
columns.description: Flag that identifies whether the mode is fixed-route or non-fixed route.

columns.name: Rail (True/False)
columns.description: Separates Rail (True) from Non-Rail (False) modes.

columns.name: Primary UZA UACE Code
columns.description: The Census Bureau's Urban Area Census Code (UACE). This five-digit code uniquely identifies an urban area and remains unchanged from census to census.

columns.name: Primary UZA Name
columns.description: The name of the Census-designated Urbanized Area, from the most recent census, in which the system primarily operates.

columns.name: Primary UZA Sq Miles
columns.description: The square miles of the primary UZA from the most recent decennial Census.

columns.name: Primary UZA Population
columns.description: The population of the primary UZA from the most recent decennial Census.

columns.name: Service Area Sq Miles
columns.description: The service area as measured in square miles for the agency as of the most recently concluded report year.

columns.name: Service Area Population
columns.description: The population residing within the service area for the agency as of the most recently concluded report year.

columns.name: Year
columns.description: The calendar year in which the events occurred.

columns.name: Month
columns.description: The month in which the events occurred.

columns.name: Month_Year (timestamp)
columns.description: The beginning of the month in which the S&S events occurred in date timestamp format.

columns.name: VOMS
columns.description: The number of revenue vehicles operated by the given mode and type of service to meet the annual maximum service requirement. This is the revenue vehicle count during the peak season of the reporting period; on the week and day that maximum service is provided. Vehicles operated in maximum service (VOMS) exclude atypical days and one-time special events.

columns.name: Vehicle Revenue Miles
columns.description: The number of miles traveled by transit vehicles in revenue service, as reported by the system for the same calendar year.  The value is year to date for calendar years that are not yet complete. For rail modes, "passenger car revenue miles" is used.

columns.name: Vehicle Revenue Hours
columns.description: The number of hours operated by transit vehicles in revenue service, as reported by the system for the same calendar year.  The value is year to date for calendar years that are not yet complete.

columns.name: Unlinked Passenger Trips
columns.description: The number of boardings on transit vehicles reported by the system for the same calendar year.  The value is year to date for calendar years that are not yet complete.

columns.name: Collisions with Motor Vehicle
columns.description: The number of collisions with a motor vehicle for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Collisions with Person
columns.description: The number of collisions with a person for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Collisions with Fixed Object
columns.description: The number of collisions with a fixed object for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Collisions with Rail Vehicle
columns.description: The number of collisions with a rail vehicle for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Collisions with Bus Vehicle
columns.description: The number of collisions with a bus vehicle for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Collisions with Other
columns.description: The number of collisions with another object for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Total Collisions
columns.description: The total number of collisions for the given agency/mode/month.

columns.name: Total Derailments
columns.description: Total number of main line derailments reported to NTD. Yard derailments are reported as Not-Otherwise Classified (NOC) events.

columns.name: Total Fires
columns.description: Total number of fires reported to NTD.

columns.name: Total Security Events
columns.description: Total number of major security events reported to NTD, including assaults on transit workers and other security events.

columns.name: Total Events Not Otherwise Classified
columns.description: Total number of accidents "not otherwise classified" (NOC) reported to NTD.  These events include slips, trips and falls, electric shocks, vehicles leaving roadway, yard derailments, and other events that are not reported as a collision, derailment, or fire.

columns.name: Total Events
columns.description: Total number reportable major and non-major events for the given agency/mode/type of service/month.
